title: Project requirement decomposition
whenToUse: Turn a fuzzy brief into testable requirements.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Decompose {{brief}} into requirements and risks.

CONTEXT:
Constraints: {{constraints}}.

INPUT:
Stakeholders (roles only): {{roles}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- No invented approvals/dates as facts
- Mark assumptions

OUTPUT:
Must/Should/Could + risks + open questions

ACCEPTANCE:
Open questions are explicit.

VERIFICATION:
Each must-have is testable.
badPrompt: Write the PRD as if approved.
improvedPrompt: Decompose POS offline-mode brief; label assumptions; list risks; no fake sign-offs.
